assessments.title: Ayurveda Clinical & Pharmacognosy Competency
assessments.description: Official Ministry of Ayush standardized assessment assessing Charaka Samhita diagnostics, Dravyaguna properties (Rasa, Guna, Virya, Vipaka), and Panchakarma execution protocols.

questions.question: Which Panchakarma procedure is indicated as the prime therapy for aggravated Pitta Dosha?
questions.rationale: According to Charaka Samhita, Virechana is the supreme therapy for eliminating Pitta from its root seat (Amashaya/Grahani).

questions.question: In Dravyaguna, what is the Vipaka of Madhura (Sweet) Rasa predominantly?
questions.rationale: Substances with Madhura and Lavana rasa generally undergo Madhura Vipaka after digestion.

questions.question: Which classical formulation type requires Schedule T (GMP) fermentation monitoring for self-generated alcohol content?
questions.rationale: Asavas and Arishtas are classical hydro-alcoholic preparations developed through natural Sandhana Kalpana (fermentation).

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a Pradhana Snehana Dravya with optimal retention capacity?
questions.rationale: Ghrita is Samskaranuvartana (inherits qualities of herbs without losing its own), making it the superior Snehana Dravya.

questions.question: What is the primary diagnostic observation assessed in Nadi Pariksha for Vataja Nadi?
questions.rationale: Vata dominance presents as Sarpa-Jalauka Gati (serpentine, swift, curved pulse).

assessments.title: Therapeutic Yoga & Naturopathy Diagnostics
assessments.description: Assesses knowledge of therapeutic asana adjustments, Shatkarma purification, hydrotherapy temperature ranges, and yogic lifestyle intervention.

questions.question: Which Shatkarma technique is specifically recommended for chronic sinusitis and upper respiratory mucus clearance?
questions.rationale: Jala Neti flushes the nasal cavity and desensitizes respiratory mucosa.

questions.question: In Naturopathy, what physiological response does a cold hip bath (55°F - 65°F) induce?
options: Pelvic vasoconstriction followed by reactionary hyperemia and visceral tone improvement
questions.rationale: Cold hydrotherapy initiates tonic vasoconstriction and invigorating reflexive blood circulation to reproductive and lower bowel organs.

questions.question: Which Asana is contraindicated for individuals suffering from severe lumbar disc herniation (Sciatica)?
questions.rationale: Intense forward flexion exerts high intradiscal pressure on posterior lumbar nerve roots.

assessments.title: Homeopathic Materia Medica & Repertorization
assessments.description: Evaluates mastery in case analysis, Kent's repertory schema, Organon §153 characteristic symptoms, and potency selection.

questions.question: According to Dr. Samuel Hahnemann's Organon §153, which symptoms guide the homeopath to the similimum?
options: Common pathology symptoms shared by all patients
Strange, rare, peculiar, and characteristic symptoms
questions.rationale: Organon §153 clearly dictates that more striking, singular, uncommon and peculiar symptoms correspond to the medicinal drug.

questions.question: Which medicine has key characteristic: 'Great thirst for small quantities of cold water at frequent intervals with extreme prostration and restlessness'?
questions.rationale: Arsenicum Album exhibits classic agonizing restlessness with sipping cold water.
